title: Scan a menu for food restrictions
lead: Take a photo of a menu or food label in {destination}. The ingredients are read, checked against each member's restrictions, and a question for the waiter is written in the local language.

group.title: The group's restrictions
group.none: This trip's plan lists no food restrictions yet. The scan still names ingredients worth asking about.

picker.title: A photo of a menu or food label
picker.hint: Point the camera at the dish name, the ingredient list, or the package label until the text is easy to read.
picker.previewAlt: The menu photo to be read
picker.readyHint: Hidden ingredients such as mirin, lard, fish stock, alcohol, or nuts are checked for every member.

errors.notImage: This file is not a photo. Choose a JPG, PNG, or HEIC photo.
errors.tooLarge: The photo is too large. Take it again or choose another one.
errors.unreadable: This browser cannot open this photo. Try taking one straight from the camera.
errors.offline: Reading a menu needs an internet connection. Connect first, then try again.
errors.failed: The menu could not be read. Try again shortly.

result.others: {count} other members have no food restrictions.

waiter.title: Ask the waiter
waiter.hint: Show this screen to the waiter or play it aloud.

noSpeech: This browser cannot read text aloud. Show the text instead.
noVoice: This phone has no {language} voice yet. Show the text instead.
